style: Precise tech-flat vector illustration in dark slate indigo (#2b2d42), tangerine (#ef8354) and light grey, clean lines with subtle circuit-trace motifs, no text.
hero: A modern repair bay: a car on a lift with a diagnostic scanner cart beside it, a tire rack and a tool wall with faint circuit-line patterns. Flat vector, DARK slate indigo overall, tangerine highlights. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people.
